## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Cloudflare) · $0.24/M input tokens · [developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef/)

<sub>[price source](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef): Cloudflare Workers AI list price, observed 2026-10-31. USD per million input tokens, including tokenized media; no output-token charge. Not a fixed price per decision. · [context source](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef): Cloudflare hosted endpoint limit, observed 2026-10-31. State, questions and tokenized media share the context window; this is not a local-memory guarantee.</sub>

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~67.7 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/Cloudflare](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef/blob/cfddda043dd190ef3b01cff449d5ee8cff1e8ec6/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   docker run --gpus all --shm-size 32g -p 30000:30000 -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface --ipc=host lmsysorg/sglang:dev-clef sglang serve --model-path Cloudflare/clef --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000
   ```

[Download model files](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef/tree/cfddda043dd190ef3b01cff449d5ee8cff1e8ec6) · Published model files verified. This is a verified repository snapshot; the benchmark does not establish an identical weight revision. See the local setup below for the reviewed runtime. [Evidence](https://huggingface.co/api/models/Cloudflare/clef/revision/cfddda043dd190ef3b01cff449d5ee8cff1e8ec6); checked 2026-10-31.

Model repository and documentation: [huggingface.co/Cloudflare](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef)
